items.title: Amar’e Stoudemire Reveals How Tracy McGrady Inspired His NBA Path | Cousins
items.author: Cousins with Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady
items.body_excerpt: Amar’e Stoudemire explains how seeing Tracy McGrady make the jump from high school to the NBA inspired him to believe he could follow a similar path. That influence ultimately played a role in Amar’e choosing Mount Zion, the same school T-Mac attended.
